claim_policy.wording: Bounded frictionless penalty contact for the documented small-sliding node-to-triangle static scope.

energy.identity: U_strain + U_contact_penalty = W_external for proportional linear-elastic load

final_gap.definition: absolute final normal gap for the active final state

force_balance.definition: maximum recorded nonlinear free residual relative to reference load norm

max_penetration.definition: max over all recorded load steps of max(-gap, 0)

mesh_refinement.definition: two-level contact force, displacement, penetration and reaction characterization
mesh_refinement.promotion_gate: none; finite, converged, traceable observations required

normal_force.comparison: strictly positive contact-force norm and non-tensile normal sign
normal_force.definition: final contact force is compressive along the frozen master normal

penalty_sensitivity.definition: penetration is non-increasing over the declared penalty sequence; every solve converges and residuals are finite

replay.comparison: exact arrays and identical status; semantic digest equality

limitations: initial small-sliding search with frozen normal and face
linear elastic isotropic TET4 solids only
no general finite sliding or self-contact
no friction qualification; the existing frictional route remains separate and unqualified by this contract
no augmented Lagrangian, mortar, impact, dynamic, MPI or nonlinear-material contact claim
penalty values are bounded tested values, not universal recommendations
